Then no decision record is written for the case

  Scenario: AC10 A user without Case record U is refused feedback (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the run of case "RW-2027-000501" has no feedback
    When a user holding Case record R only (RW-PHONECOL) sends POST /api/recovery/agent/v1/agent-runs/{runId}/feedback with verdict "ACCEPTED"
    Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002
    Then no decision record and no agent_feedback row exist for the run

  Scenario: AC11 A seed pack that cannot be loaded stops the run (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the seed pack is missing a seed item (case not owned, policy version absent, segment missing or counts off)
    When the harness starts the run
    Then the run refuses to start and names the missing seed item
    Then no scenario is reported

  Scenario: AC12 An evidence pack that cannot be attached fails the run (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the evidence pack of the run cannot be attached to the release record
    When the harness completes the run
    Then the run is marked failed
    Then the local evidence file is kept for rerun

  Scenario: AC13 The summary holds masking tokens only (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the intake run of case "RW-2027-000501" has completed
    When the harness requests GET /api/recovery/agent/v1/cases/{caseId}/agent-outputs for the case
    Then the summary holds masking tokens only and no personal data value
